A SHORT ESSAY

There are essays that have no chapters at all. This is one of them. It
goes on from one paragraph to the next without a single heading, and a
reader who wants to stop in the middle has to fold the corner of the
page.

The second paragraph says much the same thing, only more slowly, and
with a small digression about the weather, which was fine.

The third paragraph ends the essay.
